maddeler.e:
ابتنين (form VIII)
# اِبْتَنَيْنَ (ibtanayna) /ib.ta.naj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اُبْتُنِينَ (ubtunīna) /ub.tu.niː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اِبْتَنِينَ (ibtanīna) /ib.ta.niː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
